title: Consecutive Failure Alert Payload
description: Payload schema for tool-consecutive-failure-alert plugin alerts

tool_name.description: Tool name used for state keying (bare or full depending on tool_name_format)

tool_args.description: Command line arguments (command.line attribute). Empty when desensitization=summary_only.

first_action_id.description: Action ID of the first failure in the sequence

last_action_id.description: Action ID of the last failure in the sequence

failure_sequence.description: Boundaries of the consecutive failure sequence

evidence_action_ids.description: Action IDs of all failures in the consecutive sequence
